name: ClinicNotificationSettings
description: Owner-scoped notification preferences for immediate clinic activity alerts

email_recipients.description: Email recipients for owner alerts. Values must be valid email addresses.

sms_recipients.description: SMS recipients for owner alerts. Values must be E.164 phone numbers.

new_appointment_enabled.description: Whether an immediate alert is enabled when a new appointment is created

new_appointment_channels.description: Channels for new appointment alerts. Allowed values: email, sms, push.

new_inquiry_enabled.description: Whether an immediate combined lead and inbox alert is enabled for a new ContactInquiry

new_inquiry_channels.description: Channels for combined lead and inbox alerts. Allowed values: email, sms, push.

appointment_changed_enabled.description: Whether an immediate alert is enabled after a client cancellation or supported client change

appointment_changed_channels.description: Channels for client cancellation or change alerts. Allowed values: email, sms, push.

appointment_no_show_enabled.description: Whether an immediate alert is enabled when staff records an appointment no-show

appointment_no_show_channels.description: Channels for appointment no-show alerts. Allowed values: email, sms, push.

appointment_reschedule_requested_enabled.description: Whether an immediate alert is enabled when a customer submits an appointment reschedule request

appointment_reschedule_requested_channel.description: Channels for appointment reschedule request alerts. Allowed values: email, sms, push.
